answer_1.quote: Instruction fine-tuning (IFT) is an effective approach for enhancing the performance of language models in zero-shot and few-shot scenarios on previously unseen tasks.
answer_1.outputs: The paper focuses on improving instruction-following responses generated by language models through multi-agent refinement, which is a form of natural language generation.

answer_4.quote: To further conduct a human evaluation of this work, we randomly sample 50 cases from the AlpacaEval dataset and generate responses for each instruction using both the baseline model (DEITA-Mistral-7B) and the enhanced model (COEVOL-Mistral-7B MIXTRAL ). Following the human evaluation process of , we engage human annotators to manually score these responses.
